description: Search MyLatinLife's 40-course editorial ranking by country, city, access category or words. Results stay in published rank order and include the rationale, access notes and sources. Phone, email, contact-page and booking fields appear only when verified. Use find_private_clubs for the broader club directory. This endpoint is neither a complete course inventory nor a live tee-time service or objective course rating.

access_type.description: Filter by the access category stated in the current course record; confirm the venue's current rules.

city.description: Only courses whose city or region contains these words.

contact_only.description: Return only records with a verified phone, email, contact page or booking URL.

country.description: Only courses in this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

limit.description: How many ranked courses to return. Defaults to 40.

query.description: Words to match in the course name, location, rationale or access notes.

name: find_golf_courses
title: Find ranked golf courses in Latin America
